config.claim_ceiling: Training-only recursive wikitext representation screen. Exact complete candidates are development artifacts, not Axiom wins, validation results, holdout results, independent reproduction, product codecs, novel-algorithm results, or state-of-the-art evidence.

attribution.purpose: Require at least 0.50% aggregate gain from schema-value columnarization beyond recursive structure alone.

routing.no_signal: Reject recursive template/schema columnarization on this training split.
routing.signal_only: Retain diagnostic evidence; do not admit a codec.
routing.strong_signal: Admit only a separately frozen codec prototype; do not claim a product or Axiom win.

transform_frame.metadata: counted preorder invocation and parameter-order stream
transform_frame.schema_source: current input bytes only; no external template database

process_memory_limit.darwin_behavior: RLIMIT_AS is not lowered; wait4 peak RSS is measured and the same 4 GiB gate fails closed
process_memory_limit.posix_behavior: RLIMIT_AS is set before exec and wait4 peak RSS is also measured
process_memory_limit.unsupported_behavior: measurement is refused without POSIX wait4 telemetry or resource-limit support
